input_files.comment: Every .xlsx workbook dropped into paths.upload_folder is read - one workbook per project (or per project + bore split, e.g. '...182 Small Bore.xlsx' / '...182 Large Bore.xlsx', which are combined back into one project by Project Code). Each workbook must contain a sheet whose name includes 'Spool' (row-level spool list) and, optionally, a sheet named 'Summary' (row-level packing list per Box No.).

publishing.comment: When true, every run also copies the packing bundle (see output_files.bundle above) into paths.website_data_folder - the file website/packing-dispatch.html auto-loads for every visitor of the hosted site, same pattern as config/settings.json for the Production pipeline.

status_normalization.comment: Raw 'Packing Status' / Summary 'Status' text varies by project (PACKED, COMPLETE PACKED, COMPLETE PACK, DISPATCHED, or blank). See src/packing/normalize.py -> normalize_status() for the exact matching rules. Blank/missing is treated as 'Balance in Project' - i.e. the spool has not been packed into a box yet.
